source.attribution: Afrobarometer Data, Benin, Cameroon, Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana and Nigeria, Round 10, 2024, available at https://www.afrobarometer.org.

method.name: Six normalized regularized four-domain categorical latent profiles, fitted independently within each country
method.classification: Fractional posterior membership; learned class shares; no equal quantiles or observed NRS/CIE grades
method.ordering: Descending equal mean of fitted education, household ownership and absence-of-deprivation profiles. Occupation enters nominally.
method.missing: All four domains must be complete; otherwise unknown. Strata with fewer than five complete records remain unknown.
method.range: Selected union evaluated jointly across converged near-best posterior vectors. Optimization spread, approximate weighted sampling margin and unknown adult potential are separate components; not survey-design confidence intervals
method.ageBoundary: WorldPop 15_19 contributes 2/5 adult mass (ages18–19), a declared uniform within-bin age assumption; other under18 mass stays unknown
